ModMetaData.description:
Private Windows candidate with independently accepted, bounded GOG and Steam startup, correctness, agent-operated UI and workload-specific performance evidence. Linux and global release readiness remain unqualified; this private package is not an authorized public release or full ecosystem replacement.
Wake-Up avoids selected repeated loading work with definition/template and code searches, optional-mod integrations, processed XML, translation application, native PNG/JPEG output reuse, optional PSD decoding, explicit texture quality/preparation, asset routes, display/reports and loading-only background behavior. Prepatcher is required; supplier mods are optional. Optional new controls default off; additional search reuse follows the existing default-on type-search setting. Restart after settings changes.
Independent parsed XML, inheritance caching, ordered read-ahead, parsed-language persistence, authored-DDS recaching, managed first-build acceleration, static atlas caching and atlas batching are retired. Those operations use native behavior. The display retains its independent observation and scheduling of native work. On-demand assets, progressive detail and the companion app are deferred. Streaming XML remains experimental. Keep supplier capabilities you still need; Wake-Up does not replace complete supplier suites.
The optional Windows helper supports explicit quality conversion and DDS exports. Choices can change pixels and dimensions; original artwork stays intact. Ordinary DDS loading stays native. Native PNG/JPEG reuse needs no helper. The Steam inspection used the actual saved stores through native, six prepared textures and native reset launches, with ordinary copied-colony loads and focus return. A separate background hold kept the colony tick unchanged for 45 seconds, then returned focus normally. These are agent observations, not the owner's quality preference or universal gameplay compatibility. Known InputLegacyModule log messages remain.
On the corrected Steam core, small English ordinary defaults effectively tied native loading and public 0.2.1. Separate workload gains were 2.65% for the complete type/reflection group, 10.89% for French translation application and 15.78% for PNG-selected warm reuse. PNG construction added 12.05 seconds and 333.5 MB; about four subsequent matching warm launches repay that cost. These conditional percentages cannot be added and are not incremental benchmarks against public 0.2.1. Earlier GOG measurements found a cost for display observation/scheduling and slower all-options loading; those are separate historical results. Enabling everything is not a recommended performance preset. No new Steam speed claim is made for processed XML, routing, XML-query extensions, display or all-options loading. Do not enable alongside another Wake-Up or validation copy.
